name: Node Embedding
problem_statement: Learn a vector for every vertex under a declared graph representation-learning objective.

normalization: Preserve all declared vertices, including isolated vertices.
Preserve direction; an undirected projection must be explicitly requested.
Declare the treatment of self-loops and parallel edges before execution; an adapter must reject unsupported cases.

problem_inputs.name: training_parameters
problem_inputs.description: Model-specific loss, optimizer, sampling and iteration settings.

required_outputs.name: embeddings
required_outputs.description: Finite vectors with the requested dimensions.

required_outputs.name: training_summary
required_outputs.description: Loss definition, attained loss, training budget and convergence information.

solution_semantics.exactness: Numerical stochastic optimization; no unique embedding or global optimum is implied.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Output identities refer to the normalized input; any multiplicities must follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No output order or choice among equally valid optima is required unless specified by an input.

validation_rules: All declared vertices have finite vectors of the requested dimension.
Evaluate the stated objective and downstream metrics on fixed splits.
edge_cases: Embedding rotations and equivalent parameterizations are valid.

correctness: All declared vertices have finite vectors of the requested dimension.
Evaluate the stated objective and downstream metrics on fixed splits.
